title: ARFTR: Anchor-Restored Factorized Temporal Residual
description: Person-centered activity classification with actor-memory anchoring, factor-specific evidence restoration and a constrained same-track temporal residual. Retained macro-F1 is 85.383648% on 4,977 adaptively reused Okutama development centers, not independent confirmation. Includes original component evidence, a knowledge graph, aggregate verification and preserved experimental history. Project version 1.0.0 marks separation from the companion POLAR Posture Recognition benchmark, not new training or changed scores. No dataset media or model weights are distributed. This metadata does not itself indicate a Zenodo deposit or DOI.
